product_name: Sprout, a habit tracker that holds one habit at a time.
one_liner: Sprout is the habit app that only lets you track one habit until it sticks.
target_user: people who have deleted four habit apps in the last year and still want a morning routine
frustration: I quit on day four every single time and then the app just turns red at me
objection: it is one more habit app I will abandon by next Tuesday
core_features: One habit at a time. The Add button stays locked until day 14.
A day count that holds when you miss a day, instead of resetting to zero.
A plant that drops one leaf on a missed day and keeps growing.
A four week view that shows the thin patches without scoring them.
demo_moment: Tap a missed Tuesday. One leaf falls and the day count stays on nine.
allowed_claims: Setting up a habit takes one field and under 11 seconds.
Missing a day never resets the day count.
The Add button is locked until the first habit is 14 days old.
forbidden_claims: No health, medical, or mental health outcomes.
No claim that Sprout works for everyone or that results are permanent.
proof_assets: The App Store rating screenshot, current as of this month.
cta: Download Sprout and set up one habit tonight. It is free to start and there is nothing to cancel.
